parsed.reply: Because the sensation is the subject of the sentence, not you. «La nariz» (or whatever is itching) is doing the pinching or biting, and you are the indirect object («me») it happens to. You say «me pica la nariz» the same way you say «me duele la cabeza» — my head hurts.
